# Core profile

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_core_profile.py from the `core` subset of the
     schema. Do not edit by hand; run `just core-profile`. -->

The `core` subset is the minimal record: what most datasets should fill and
what a database should index. It covers the study and its cultivation, the
tracer design, the method and software of each run, the flux results with
their uncertainty, and the native source files.

Everything else in the schema is optional detail. Benchmarks need some of it
(networks, atom transitions, measurements; see VALIDATION_REQUIREMENTS.md),
and tool provenance uses the rest (solver options, residuals, scale factors).
`fluxo ingest` fills most fields from the native files, so nobody types them
by hand.

**59 core fields in 12 classes**, out of 346 fields in
37 classes. Required fields are marked; the rest are recommended.

## FluxoDataset

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Unique identifier for this dataset. |
| `name` | string |  | Human-readable name of the dataset. |
| `dataset_type` | DatasetTypeEnum |  | Classification of this dataset by curation tier. |
| `source_files` | SourceFile (list) |  | Native MFA files referenced by this dataset (FluxML, MTF, FTBL, .mat, etc.). |
| `conditions` | Condition (list) |  | All cultivation conditions in this dataset, defined once and referenced by LabelingExperiment.condition and SimulationRun.condition. |
| `investigations` | Investigation (list) |  | All MFA investigations in this dataset. |
| `experiments` | LabelingExperiment (list) |  | All labeling experiments in this dataset. |
| `simulation_runs` | SimulationRun (list) |  | All simulation runs in this dataset. |

## Investigation

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Unique identifier for the investigation. |
| `name` | string | yes | Human-readable name of the investigation. |
| `publication_doi` | uriorcurie |  | DOI of the associated publication. |
| `investigation_type` | InvestigationTypeEnum |  | Kind of fluxomics investigation this is (FLUXO:0000162 subtree). |

## Condition

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Unique identifier for the condition record. |
| `organism_name` | string |  | Name of the organism (e.g., Escherichia coli). |
| `strain` | string |  | Strain designation (e.g., BW25113). |
| `specific_growth_rate` | float |  | Measured specific growth rate of the organism. |
| `growth_rate_unit` | string |  | Unit for the growth rate (e.g., 1/h). |

## LabelingExperiment

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Unique identifier for the experiment. |
| `investigation_id` | Investigation |  | Reference to the parent investigation. |
| `condition` | Condition |  | Reference to the cultivation condition for this experiment, defined once in FluxoDataset.conditions. |
| `data_origin` | DataOriginEnum |  | Whether the measurement values are experimental, synthetic or simulated. |
| `stationary` | boolean | yes | Whether the experiment is isotopically stationary (true) or non-stationary/INST (false). |
| `labeled_sources` | LabeledSource (list) |  | Labeled substrate (tracer mixture) specifications. |

## LabeledSource

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Unique identifier for the labeled source. |
| `metabolite_id` | NetworkMetabolite | yes | Reference to the input metabolite in the network model. |
| `tracers` | TracerIsotopomer (list) |  | Individual tracer isotopomers in the mixture. |

## TracerIsotopomer

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `labeling_pattern` | string | yes | Labeling pattern as a binary string where 1 = labeled atom and 0 = unlabeled atom (e.g., "100000" for [1-13C]glucose). |
| `tracer_fraction` | float |  | Proportion of this tracer isotopomer in the labeled source. |
| `isotopic_purity` | float |  | Purity of the isotopic label (e.g., 0.99 for 99 atom % 13C). |

## SimulationRun

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Unique identifier for the simulation run. |
| `investigation_id` | Investigation |  | Reference to the parent investigation. |
| `experiment_id` | LabelingExperiment (list) |  | Reference(s) to the labeling experiment(s) used. |
| `fluxomics_method` | FluxomicsMethodEnum |  | The fluxomics method this run realises — a value from the FLUXO:0000021 subtree. |
| `run_mode` | RunModeEnum (list) |  | What the run did: estimation, forward simulation, confidence intervals, Monte Carlo, ... |
| `software` | SoftwareInfo | yes | Software tool and version used for this run. |
| `flux_solution` | FluxSolution |  | Results of the run: estimated (or reference / simulated) flux values, pool sizes, simulated measurements and fit residuals. |
| `goodness_of_fit` | GoodnessOfFit |  | Goodness-of-fit statistics for the solution. |
| `input_files` | SourceFile (list) |  | Native input files used for this simulation run, by id into FluxoDataset.source_files (network, measurements, tracers, constraints, configuration). |

## GoodnessOfFit

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `wssr` | float |  | Weighted sum of squared residuals (variance-weighted). |
| `degrees_of_freedom` | integer |  | Degrees of freedom in the fit. |

## Example

A complete core record (`examples/valid/minimal_core_record.yaml`, illustrative values):

```yaml
# The smallest useful FluxoLink record: one 13C-MFA study, filled with the
# `core` subset only (docs/core_profile.md). ILLUSTRATIVE values: the study,
# numbers and tool version are made up to show the shape, not taken from a
# publication.
#
# Add `source_files` (with sha256 checksums) when you have the native input
# and output files; add networks and measurements only for a benchmark.
id: minimal_core_record
name: Minimal core record (illustrative)
dataset_type: catalog

investigations:
  - id: INV1
    name: Glucose 13C-MFA of E. coli BW25113 (illustrative)
    investigation_type: MFA

conditions:
  - id: COND1
    organism_name: Escherichia coli
    strain: BW25113
    specific_growth_rate: 0.6
    growth_rate_unit: 1/h

experiments:
  - id: EXP1
    investigation_id: INV1
    condition: COND1
    data_origin: experimental
    stationary: true
    labeled_sources:
      - id: GLC
        metabolite_id: Gluc_ext
        tracers:
          - {labeling_pattern: "100000", tracer_fraction: 0.8, isotopic_purity: 0.99}
          - {labeling_pattern: "111111", tracer_fraction: 0.2, isotopic_purity: 0.99}

simulation_runs:
  - id: RUN1
    investigation_id: INV1
    experiment_id: [EXP1]
    fluxomics_method: IST_MFA
    run_mode: [estimation, confidence_interval_estimation]
    software: {id: SW1, software_name: INCA, version: "2.3"}
    flux_solution:
      id: SOL1
      flux_results:
        - reaction_id: PGI
          flux_type: net
          value: 61.2
          lower_ci: 58.0
          upper_ci: 64.1
          confidence_level: 0.95
          confidence_interval_method: parameter_continuation
          flux_unit: mmol/gDW/h
        - reaction_id: G6PDH
          flux_type: net
          value: 36.9
          lower_ci: 34.2
          upper_ci: 39.5
          confidence_level: 0.95
          confidence_interval_method: parameter_continuation
          flux_unit: mmol/gDW/h
    goodness_of_fit:
      wssr: 42.1
      degrees_of_freedom: 38
      chi_square_p_value: 0.30
```
